event.title: eWEAR Health Prize @ Stanford U.
event.ticket_cost: Free for eWEAR Affiliate member companies & the Stanford University community; $50 for external attendees
event.description:
Deep Tech and AI for the Medical/Health Sector with brain-machine interfaces, longevity, precision health, robotics, or wearables.

Start-ups compete for a $25,000 cash prize. Keynote with John L. Hennessy, President Emeritus

Agenda & Speakers:

12:30 pm | Badge pick-up opens
1:00 pm | Welcome
      Angela McIntyre, eWEAR Executive Director
      Prof. Xiang Qian, MD, eWEAR Co-Faculty Director
1:10pm | Keynote & Fireside Chat
      John L. Hennessy, President Emeritus of Stanford, Co-founder, Knight-Hennessy Scholars and Chairman of Alphabet
      Moderator: Prof. Zhenan Bao, eWEAR Faculty Director
1:45 pm | Pitches
International Participation
AlignSight Medical (National Taiwan University)
Phantom (National University of Singapore)
HICKY, Inc. / SomniHeart, Inc. (The University of Tokyo)
Finalist Competition
Lume Health | Vicki Powell
CircuCare | Sai Zhou
Microvitality | Sofia Paschenti
Fibionics | Muhammad Khatib
Neurosmart | Julius Klaas
3:45 pm | Awards
4:00 pm | Start-up Demo Showcase & Networking Reception
5:00 pm | Conclusion of event

schema.name: Find Your Space in the Library
schema.description: As a commuter or transfer student, stepping past the first floor of the University Library can feel uncertain or intimidating. You might wonder which spaces are best for focused studying, hanging out with friends, or taking a well-deserved nap and what the noise expectations are for each area. The University Library is here to help you confidently explore, navigate, and claim the spaces that fit your lifestyle and learning needs.        Dinner will be provided.    We’d love for you to RSVP, and feel free to bring a friend or two.    Location: Learning Commons, Viewing & Production-B (LC 133)    11125721933
